title: Justify
description: A lyric set as a force-justified block in soft black Arial on white, two or three words to a line with wide uneven gaps. Drag the right edge and every word glides on its own spring to its new slot; click in to rewrite it live, and turn the softness from crisp to upscaled-JPEG mush.
intent: One typographic mechanic finished to the edge: force-justification as a live material, where the measure is the only control and the gaps are the design.
sources: herb reference board: 0fc59ca9 (I'm a star justified block) and ee6eda60 (the sun'll come out, blurred justified block)
